text:
maria_infra: heads up, onboarding fleet in eu-west-1 is failing to join. seeing KMS decrypt errors during node bootstrap and warm-pool jobs are timing out.

sam_oncall: saw spikes in conntrack and a bunch of `TLS handshake` failures to the keystore. any recent fw changes?

maria_infra: ops team rolled a default-deny egress policy to tighten outbound in privnet yesterday. thought the keystore CIDR was allowed, but looks like the nat-gw -> keystore path got blocked for the new AZ.

kevin_platform: ouch. that explains why GPU nodes can't fetch bootstrap secrets. error dump from one node:```
2026-03-19T21:10:12Z node-init error: kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
caused by: network unreachable: dial tcp 10.45.12.34:443
```

eva_security: default-deny rollout should have been staged. we have audit logs showing the rule set change at 20:05 UTC yesterday (iam: infra-deploy-bot). I'm triggering a quick policy diff.

deploy-bot: Policy change detected: `egress: DENY 0.0.0.0/0` (previously ALLOW -> restricted list). Changed by infra-deploy-bot at 2026-03-19T20:05:02Z.

sam_oncall: short-term mitigation: can we add a targeted allow for `keystore.redwood-internal.svc` IPs from the warm-pool subnet? That should unblock onboarding fast.

kevin_platform: +1. Also need to ensure conntrack connlimit isn't exhausted. We're seeing `nf_conntrack` table near 65535 entries for that nat-gw; might be unrelated but contributes to weird TLS hangs.

maria_infra: adding allow for keystore ips now. patch:```
- egress: deny all
+ egress: allow 10.200.5.0/24 -> 10.45.12.32/28 (keystore), allow 10.200.5.0/24 -> 169.254.169.254 (IMDS)
```
rolling out to eu-west-1-a first.

eva_security: please also add an audit tag in the rule comment with PR id so we can track who/why allowed it. we'll follow up with a least-privilege exception doc.

sam_oncall: after patch applied nodes started to progress: two nodes joined the warm pool, gpu provisioning resumed. still seeing a few `keystore handshake timeout` traces (5xx) for older bootstrap attempts, but new ones are green.

kevin_platform: next steps: 1) run conntrack sweep on the NATs (coord with netops), 2) update staging rollout to include these keystore CIDRs before enforcing default-deny, 3) record cost impact — we had ~12 failed reprovisions which retried and costed ~18 GPU-minutes. I'll add to the billing ticket.

maria_infra: noted. I'm opening a short postmortem and a runbook tweak: `runbook/egress-hardening.md` — include a preflight check script that probes keystore/KMS endpoints from a canary instance in each AZ.

eva_security: also follow up: we need KMS audit logs correlated with the firewall diffs so we can detect decryption failures caused by policy changes automatically. Can infra-platform add a CloudWatch/Loki alert: `kms.Decrypt error rate increase` + `egress policy change` within 10m -> pager?

kevin_platform: will prototype an alert. low-noise threshold first.

maria_infra: thanks all. temporary allow will stay until we finalize canary + automated guardrails. action items assigned in thread: maria -> write PM, kevin -> conntrack + billing, eva -> audit correlation rule, sam -> confirm warm-pool health in next 2 hours.

sam_oncall: confirmed warm-pool steady at target 6/6 after remediation. closing incident once postmortem acked. :white_check_mark:
